$comment: Cited ADRs that have no document in docs/adr/ (TASK-OSS-P3-01, ADR-19).
This is a DEBT LEDGER, not a permission list. `validate:adr-references` fails on any
ADR number cited anywhere in the repository that is neither documented nor listed here,
so the set can only shrink. Writing one of these ADRs means deleting its entry and
lowering maxUndocumented in the same change.
Titles are transcribed from wherever the decision is currently recorded — usually the
table in CLAUDE.md, otherwise the source comment that cites it. They are summaries of
what the code does, NOT approved decision records; that is the whole point of the debt.

undocumented.title: Manifest-driven public API: TypeScript interfaces for every public component, exports generated from public-api.manifest.json
Contract-first design; variant, size and tone taxonomies are frozen
Token-only styling: tv() recipes, no <style scoped>, no raw color literals
undocumented.recordedIn: CLAUDE.md § Key ADRs and § Styling; enforced by validate:tokens and validate:scoped-style

undocumented.title: compat isolation: stable core and pro must never import from @dzup-ui/compat
undocumented.recordedIn: packages/compat/src header comments; enforced by validate:boundaries

undocumented.title: Reka UI as the headless primitive layer
Compound component wiring by provide/inject with a typed injection key per family
undocumented.recordedIn: packages/contracts/src/compound.types.ts; the DZ_*_KEY declarations in each family

undocumented.title: Theme context: DzThemeProvider exposes a minimal inject API consumed through useTheme
Class merging through cn() (clsx + tailwind-merge); consumer class always merges into the root
ESM-only distribution: no .cjs artifact in any published dist

Calendar and date-picker date math delegated to @internationalized/date via the useCalendar composable. NOTE: dzup-ui-pro numbers a different decision ADR-13 (neutral models) — the two tiers share a number space and do not coordinate it, which is itself worth a decision
FOUC prevention: a synchronous theme script sets data-theme before first paint
defineModel for v-model rather than manual prop + emit pairs
Token source of truth and component token ownership (hybrid model: tokens package owns primitives/semantic, components may own anatomy mapping)
